messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: scheduled canary for service=llm-routing image=redwood/llm-route:v2.9.0 in ~10m. Feature-flag rollout plan: llmroute_adaptive_cache -> start shadow-prefill (no user traffic) for 20m, then 0.5% -> 3% -> 12% over 2.5h. Change window 22:30-03:30 UTC. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/4155559999. @clara @zane

clara: quick note 14 staging replay showed a small token tail when cache prefill triggers concurrently across replicas. prefer to run a preflight shadow-prefill run and add a shard-stagger to ramp.

zane: agree. please keep initial cohorts as shadow only. also add per-replica stagger: delay-start 6s so prefill doesn't thundering-herd.

deploy-bot: Rollout config default: shadow-prefill enabled, no stagger. Automation will follow plan unless manual hold is requested.

ops-ash: putting canary into preflight mode and setting llmroute_adaptive_cache=shadow-prefill now. Logged: "preflight: shadow-prefill, hold for QA + stagger tweak" :gear:

qa-lee: running targeted preflight replay (shadow-prefill) against v2.9.0 capturing prefill timing, startup CPU, and per-replica inflight. ETA ~14m. Will post summary.

clara: if preflight shows safe tail, we want tiny live soak: 0.5% for 30m with shard-stagger in place, then step to 3% if stable. Rolling pin command ready if needed.

zane: drafting the staggers and safety gates: stagger=6s per-replica, max-prefill-per-minute=10, safety-gate: p99 tokens > baseline +9% for 10m abort. Also add a fast abort on error-rate >0.5%.

ops-ash: safety gates added to rollout policy, stagger config saved to rollout overrides. Canary remains in preflight shadow. Notifying PMs.

qa-lee: preflight results: shadow-prefill looked OK overall but 4/250 traces show simultaneous prefill spikes at startup leading to ~15% p99 blip for <20s. These align with lower-capacity pods (2 CPU).

clara: ok that's helpful. plan: (1) increase stagger to 10s for low-cpu pods, (2) cap prefill concurrency to 4 pods/min for nodes under 4 CPU, (3) re-run preflight. If fixed, proceed to live soak with tiny cohorts.

zane: I'll prepare the rollout-config override with per-node caps and stagger map. Will push to staging in 5m.

ops-ash: override applied: stagger map + prefill concurrency caps. Canary still shadow. Logged change and updated release note draft: "Canary preflighted; prefill concurrency tweak applied to avoid startup spikes. Manual approval required to advance."

qa-lee: re-run preflight done 14 prefill spikes reduced and transient blips <5% vs baseline. Recommend proceed to manual live soak: 0.5% (30m) -> 3% (90m) -> 12% (rest) with shard-stagger active and safety gates.

clara: ready to proceed. please ensure rollback snippet is pinned and support is notified. Rollback plan (quick pin + drain):

```nredwoodctl route pin --service llm-routing --version v2.8.6 --reason "canary prefill regressions"
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 4155559999
redwoodctl traffic drain --service llm-routing --slice canary --grace 120s
```n
pm-jo: draft release-note for PMs: "Canary v2.9.0: started shadow prefill preflight; prefill concurrency adjusted after traces; proceeding to conservative live soak with shard-stagger and safety gates. Support on standby."

ops-ash: PM notified, support on pager. initiating manual live soak now: setting llmroute_adaptive_cache=0.5% for canaries. monitoring dashboards pinned to token p99 by shard. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Manual soak started by ops-ash: 0.5% live cohort active. Automation remains disabled; manual approvals required for next steps. Aborts will trigger pin + abort + drain.

qa-lee: first 30m of soak: stable, no sustained p99 increase. two short <20s blips noted on small pods but within allowed transient window.

zane: advance to 3% with same stagger and gates. ops-ash, please proceed when ready.

ops-ash: advancing to 3% now. safety gates live. watching closely.

clara: good run so far. keep thread open until final roll to 12% or rollback. If any gate trips, follow rollback snippet above and notify PM + support immediately.

deploy-bot: Canary update logged. Artifacts and run logs at https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/4155559999. Thread will remain open until final status: rolled-forward or rolled-back.
